name: @tank/gcp-to-terraform
description: Safely adopt existing Google Cloud infrastructure into Terraform using 2026 core/provider releases, Magic Modules internals, maintainer issues, GCP consistency behavior, and brownfield reports. Covers partial list/query support, generated-config traps, IAM authority, deletion controls, remote state, and cutover. Triggers: migrate GCP to Terraform, Terraform query GCP, Google provider import, brownfield GCP, generated config failure, GCP IAM Terraform.
